ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm) RMM-agent install from user-delivered MSI — Atera / ScreenConnect / Syncro / SimpleHelp / Action1 / R
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's signature initial-access pattern: spear-phishing delivery of a legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management (RMM) installer that the operator then uses as an interactive C2 (no malware payload required). Flags msiexec.exe or installer EXEs from user temp/download paths whose process tree resolves to an RMM-vendor product when that RMM is not part of the org's 30-day baseline. Tied to MuddyWater by repeated documented use of Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, SimpleHelp, AnyDesk and Action1 across CISA AA22-055A, AA24-057A and Group-IB 2023 reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","AteraAgent.exe","AgentPackageSTRemote.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","Syncro.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","SimpleService.exe","Remote Utilities*.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","action1_agent.exe","Action1.exe","AnyDesk.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*atera*","*ScreenConnect*","*syncro*","*simplehelp*","*remoteutil*","*rutserv*","*action1*","*anydesk*","*RemoteUtilities*") OR Processes.process_path IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Public\\*")) AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","explorer.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","acrord32.exe","OneDrive.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let RmmBins = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","agentpackagestremote.exe","screenconnect.clientsetup.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","syncro.exe","syncrosetup.exe","simpleservice.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","action1_agent.exe","action1.exe","anydesk.exe"]);
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["atera","screenconnect","connectwise","syncro","simplehelp","remoteutilities","rutserv","action1","anydesk"]);
let RmmBaseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where FileName in~ (RmmBins) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
    | summarize by DeviceName;       // hosts that legitimately run RMM
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName in~ (RmmBins))
    or (FileName =~ "msiexec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
    or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "msiexec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Public\")
    or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","acrord32.exe","onedrive.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe")
| join kind=leftanti RmmBaseline on DeviceName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

| (regex("(?i)(atera|screenconnect|connectwise|syncro|simplehelp|remoteutil|rutserv|action1|anydesk)", field=CommandLine) OR ImageFileName=/\\(ateraagent|screenconnect|syncro|rutserv|action1|anydesk)/i)

ucs.rationale: MuddyWater's 'use a legit RMM as your backdoor' tradecraft is unusual enough that it's now the actor's tier-1 signature: every major MuddyWater write-up since 2021 (CISA AA22-055A, AA24-057A, Group-IB Aug 2023, Deep Instinct Phobos/2023, Check Point 'BugSleep' 2024) opens with this exact pattern — phishing PDF/HTML link → MSI of Atera/ScreenConnect/RemoteUtilities/Syncro/SimpleHelp/Action1/AnyDesk

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater POWERSTATS / BugSleep multi-stage loader — Office or LOLBin (mshta/rundll32/wscript) spawning PowerShell with web-fetch / encoded
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's canonical loader chain: a maldoc or HTA/JS link (T1204.001/.002) launches mshta.exe, rundll32.exe, wscript.exe or cscript.exe, which then spawns powershell.exe with -EncodedCommand or in-memory Net.WebClient/Invoke-WebRequest/DownloadString. This chain is the documented delivery vector for POWERSTATS (a.k.a. POWERMUD), SHARPSTATS, and the BugSleep/MuddyRot 2024 implant, observed across MERCURY/Static Kitten/Seedworm reporting from Symantec, Trend Micro, Talos, Check Point and Mandiant since 2017.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","hh.exe","acrord32.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*-EncodedCommand*","*-enc *","*-EC *","*FromBase64String*","*DownloadString*","*Invoke-WebRequest*","*Invoke-Expression*","*IEX(*","*Net.WebClient*","*Start-BitsTransfer*","*-w hidden*","*-windowstyle hidden*","*-nop *","*-noprofile*","*-ep bypass*","*-executionpolicy bypass*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LoaderParents = dynamic(["mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","hh.exe","acrord32.exe"]);
let PsLoaderTokens = dynamic([
    "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","FromBase64String",
    "DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest","Invoke-RestMethod",
    "Net.WebClient","System.Net.WebClient","Start-BitsTransfer",
    "Invoke-Expression","IEX(","IEX (",
    "-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-nop ","-noprofile",
    "-ep bypass","-executionpolicy bypass"
  ]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LoaderParents)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (PsLoaderTokens)
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)(?:-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?))\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend DecodedB64 = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent       = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandParent  = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ChildCmd     = ProcessCommandLine,
          DecodedB64,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

title: MuddyWater Multi-Stage PowerShell Loader from Office or LOLBin Parent
id: 6f3a2b88-1c8c-4d4a-9c7b-9e8a4f2d11c5
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm / Static Kitten / Seedworm) POWERSTATS / BugSleep style loader where mshta, rundll32, wscript, cscript, or an Office application spawns powershell with web-fetch or encoded-command tokens.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-055a
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2024/new-bugsleep-backdoor-deployed-in-recent-muddywater-campaigns/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.g0069
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
      - '\acrord32.exe'
  selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - '-EC '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Invoke-RestMethod'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX('
      - 'IEX ('
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-windowstyle hidden'
      - '-nop '
      - '-noprofile'
      - '-ep bypass'
      - '-executionpolicy bypass'
  condition: selection_image and selection_parent and selection_cmdline
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts launched from cscript/wscript wrappers
  - Some EDR / patch-management tooling that wraps PowerShell via rundll32
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) AND @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\PWSH.EXE) AND @ParentImage:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\hh.exe OR *\HH.EXE OR *\acrord32.exe OR *\AcroRd32.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*-EncodedCommand* OR *-encodedcommand* OR *"-enc "* OR *"-ec "* OR *FromBase64String* OR *frombase64string* OR *DownloadString* OR *downloadstring* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *invoke-webrequest* OR *Invoke-RestMethod* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *net.webclient* OR *Start-BitsTransfer* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *invoke-expression* OR *"IEX("* OR *"iex("* OR *"-w hidden"* OR *"-windowstyle hidden"* OR *"-nop "* OR *-noprofile* OR *"-ep bypass"* OR *"-executionpolicy bypass"*)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|wscript|cscript|winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|hh|acrord32)\.exe$/i
